name: New England Clam Chowder
ingredientsText: Cream, clam stock (water, cooked clams [clams, water, corn starch, salt, clam broth, sugar, potato flour, natural flavor, onion powder, codfish powder]), potatoes, clam meat, onions, contains 2% or less of: butter (cream, salt), modified corn & tapioca starch, garlic, water, sea salt, nisin preparation, spices.
notes: Clams are molluscs, so shellfish is not contains; the 'May contain crustacean shellfish' line makes it may_contain. Codfish powder is fish.
